profile.name: MI6960 光功率计
profile.description: MI6960 光功率计用于实验室中测量激光或其他光源的输出功率。它支持自动校准与归零，并可设置校准因子、偏置、线性修正、平均次数和参考值等测量参数。
profile.description_en: The MI6960 optical power meter is used in laboratories to measure the output power of lasers or other light sources. It supports automatic calibration and zeroing, and allows configuration of measurement parameters such as calibration factor, offset, linearity correction, averaging, and reference level.
